name: AI-Powered Test Execution Agents
description: Self-contained architecture of the UI and API test execution agents owned by this repository. The orchestrator, LLM provider and system under test are modeled only as external systems.

nodes.name: UI Test Execution Agent
nodes.description: Drives the system under test via computer vision and mouse/keyboard control, using a Neo4j-backed knowledge graph for UI element and procedure grounding. It serves two endpoints on two ports. The A2A endpoint is reachable only from inside the VPC and requires an `Authorization: Bearer <AGENT_AUTH_TOKEN>` header; a missing or mismatched token is rejected with 401. If AGENT_AUTH_TOKEN is unset, the endpoint is open and a warning is logged (local development only). The operator panel is public, served over HTTPS with the PEM pair from PANEL_TLS_CERT/PANEL_TLS_KEY (plain HTTP with a warning on local runs) and protected by a password login (PANEL_PASSWORD) with a session cookie; it carries every operator interaction (timeline, prompts, the live screen relayed from Xvnc over a Unix domain socket inside the container, knowledge graph health and exploration).

interfaces.description: A2A endpoint called by the orchestrator. The GCE VM sets PORT=443.
Operator panel: the web page, its REST API, the SSE event stream and the WebSocket relay of the live screen.
interfaces.protocol: HTTPS with SSE and WebSocket (plain HTTP on local runs)
interfaces.authentication: Password login (PANEL_PASSWORD) with a session cookie

nodes.name: API Test Execution Agent
nodes.description: Drives the system under test by calling its HTTP APIs. The main A2A endpoint requires an `Authorization: Bearer <AGENT_AUTH_TOKEN>` header; a missing or mismatched token is rejected with 401. If AGENT_AUTH_TOKEN is unset, the endpoint is open and a warning is logged (local development only).

interfaces.description: A2A endpoint called by the orchestrator. On Cloud Run the container listens on PORT=8005 behind the service's HTTPS URL with internal ingress.
interfaces.protocol: A2A JSON-RPC over HTTP (HTTPS through Cloud Run)

nodes.name: Neo4j Knowledge Graph
nodes.description: Knowledge graph database storing UI elements and procedures used by the UI test execution agent for element grounding, and the history of its execution runs with their step resolutions.

nodes.name: QuAIA Orchestrator
nodes.description: External QuAIA orchestrator that routes test-execution tasks to both agents over the A2A protocol. Owned and operated outside this repository.

nodes.name: LLM Provider
nodes.description: LLM provider used by both agents for vision grounding, test case extraction, and step/precondition execution decisions: a vendor API (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Groq, Anthropic) or a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible model service (Holo3.1, Qwen3.8) on Cloud Run, which the agents call with a Google identity token, or Qwen3.8 on a Compute Engine Spot VM reached through an IAP tunnel and called with an API key.

nodes.name: System Under Test
nodes.description: External application under test, driven by the UI agent through UI interaction and by the API agent through its HTTP APIs.

nodes.name: GCE VM
nodes.description: Google Compute Engine VM hosting the UI test execution agent in a Docker container. It publishes two ports: the A2A port (443), which the firewall opens to the VPC only, and the operator panel port (8443), open to the panel's source ranges. The X display is served by Xvnc on a Unix domain socket inside the container, so no VNC or noVNC port is published.

nodes.name: Cloud Run
nodes.description: Google Cloud Run hosting the API test execution agent and the self-hosted Holo3.1 and Qwen3.8 model services (Holo3.1 from ui_test_execution_agent/deployment/holo).

nodes.name: OpenTelemetry Collector
nodes.description: External OpenTelemetry collector receiving the GenAI token-usage and call-duration metrics of both agents over OTLP. Configured through the standard OTEL_* environment variables and not provisioned by this repository; with no endpoint configured the agents export nothing.

nodes.name: Operator
nodes.description: The person who supervises the UI agent's runs in a browser: answers its prompts, watches or drives the live screen and reviews the knowledge graph. The panel credential belongs to one person, so the panel has no user identities.

relationships.description: Orchestrator routes test-execution tasks to both agents over A2A (HTTPS to the API agent on Cloud Run, HTTP inside the VPC to the UI agent).
UI agent reads/writes the knowledge graph (Bolt).
UI agent calls the LLM provider (HTTPS).
API agent calls the LLM provider (HTTPS).
UI agent drives the system under test via UI interaction.
API agent calls the system under test HTTP APIs.
UI agent runs in a Docker container on the GCE VM, which publishes the A2A port to the VPC only and the operator panel port publicly; no VNC or noVNC port is published.
API agent runs on Cloud Run.
UI agent exports its GenAI metrics to the OpenTelemetry collector (OTLP).
API agent exports its GenAI metrics to the OpenTelemetry collector (OTLP).
Operator supervises runs, answers prompts, reviews the knowledge graph health and explores the knowledge graph through the operator panel over HTTPS with a password login.
